# 延续者从其外得到供给：汲入律的输送形式；在可判定相等之下，从其外得到供给恰是该步不内向；必要的是得到供给，不必有哪个来源条件复现 / A continuing family is fed from beyond: the conveyance form of the draw-in laws; with equality decided, being fed from beyond is exactly a step that is not inward; being fed is needed, and no source condition need recur

## 主张 Claim

跨从 t 起的一步，一个参与的形成从 c 取用并向 d 给予时，有东西从 c 输送到 d（Flow.Conveys）；有东西从家族 ds 之外的条件输送入它的某个成员时，家族在该步从其外得到供给（Flow.FedFromBeyond）。家族在某步从其外得到供给时，该步不内向（Flow.not_inward_of_fed）；相等可判定时，没有从其外得到供给的一步是内向的（Flow.inward_of_not_fed），所以二者恰相反（Flow.inward_iff_not_fed），驳倒“从某步起每步都内向”的，也驳倒“从某步起都没有东西从其外输送入”（Flow.fed_of_not_inward）。于是在平衡与耗散之下，从某步起被围住的、不重复的有限家族，若取用它复现（Flow.fed_from_beyond，由 taking_draws_in），若它的成员在任意晚的步上升（Flow.rising_fed_from_beyond，由 rising_draws_in），或以一类关系项读、体现的成员在任意晚的步生起（Web.generation_fed_from_beyond，由 Web.generation_draws_in），就不能从某步起都没有东西从其外输送入。必要的是得到供给，不必有哪个来源条件复现：在平衡、耗散、吃者每步取用的 Lone 中（Lone.lone），池每步都从其外得到供给，而每份燃料只在它自己的那一步被输送出（Lone.fed、Lone.each_fuel_once、Lone.fed_not_recurring）；输送的始终是同一个源。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Across the step from t, something is conveyed from c to d when a formation taking part takes from c and gives to d (Flow.Conveys); a family ds is fed from beyond across the step when something is conveyed from a condition outside it into one of its members (Flow.FedFromBeyond). A step at which the family is fed from beyond is not inward (Flow.not_inward_of_fed); with equality decided, a step at which it is not fed from beyond is inward (Flow.inward_of_not_fed), so the two are exact opposites (Flow.inward_iff_not_fed), and whatever refutes ‘inward at every step from some step on’ refutes ‘fed from nothing beyond from some step on’ (Flow.fed_of_not_inward). So under balance and dissipation a finite family without repetition, enclosed around from some step on, cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it, whether taking from it recurs (Flow.fed_from_beyond, from taking_draws_in), its members rise at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.rising_fed_from_beyond, from rising_draws_in), or, read with one kind of relatum, embodied members arise at arbitrarily late steps (Web.generation_fed_from_beyond, from Web.generation_draws_in). Being fed is needed, and no source condition need recur: in Lone, balanced and dissipative with an eater taking at every step (Lone.lone), the pool is fed from beyond at every step while each fuel is conveyed from at its own step only (Lone.fed, Lone.each_fuel_once, Lone.fed_not_recurring); the one source does all the conveying. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 平衡（Flow.Balances）与耗散（Flow.Dissipative）：同 no-finite-part-bears-taking，是表示中的物理前提，各有满足与不满足它的世界。 / Balance (Flow.Balances) and dissipation (Flow.Dissipative): as in no-finite-part-bears-taking, physical premises of the representation, each met by some worlds and not by others.
- 家族不重复（Distinct），从某步起被围住（Around）；取用复现、成员上升复现或体现成员生起复现，三者各为一条定理的假设。 / The family is without repetition (Distinct) and enclosed around from some step on (Around); recurring taking, recurring rising and recurring embodied arising are each the hypothesis of one theorem.
- 相等可判定：inward_of_not_fed 及由它推出的定理需要它，是表示的逻辑承诺，同 Flow.Enclosed.around。 / Decided equality: inward_of_not_fed and the theorems drawn from it need it, a logical commitment of the representation, as in Flow.Enclosed.around.
- 构造性的形式：结论是“不能从某步起都没有东西从其外输送入”，不给出输送入发生的某一步；由它得出“在任意晚的步得到供给”需要全知。 / The constructive form: the conclusion is that the family cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it; it exhibits no step at which it is fed, and reading it as ‘fed at arbitrarily late steps’ needs omniscience.

Ren 的提议说：“the pure "self" is an illusion, where only when outside exists, there is the system, if the system depends on external resources”。汲入律（no-finite-part-bears-taking、generation-is-replenishment）已说：被围住时，有形成向家族给予并从其外取用。本结果把同一规律陈述为从外输送入家族，并在可判定相等之下证明两种形式等价：输送的形式只加可判定相等，不丢失内容。作者的读法（AI 论证）：延续的自我与其外之物一起延续；边界是形成的、实在的，而在其内延续的东西跨边界得到供给。这是动力学，不是伦理：它说一个延续者必须计入什么，不说它应当计入。Lone 说明必要的是得到供给，不必有哪个来源条件复现；它没有说明不需要特定的来源形成：输送的始终是同一个源。 / Ren's proposal says: “the pure "self" is an illusion, where only when outside exists, there is the system, if the system depends on external resources”. The draw-in laws (no-finite-part-bears-taking, generation-is-replenishment) said that, enclosed around, some formation gives to the family and takes from beyond it. This result states the same law as conveyance into the family from beyond and shows the two forms equivalent with equality decided: the conveyance form adds only decided equality and loses nothing. The author's reading (an AI argument): a self that continues does so together with what lies beyond it; the boundary is formed and real, while what continues within it is fed across it. This is dynamics, not ethics: it says what a continuing formation must count, not that it ought to count it. Lone shows that being fed is needed and no source condition need recur; it does not show that no particular source formation is needed, since the one source does all the conveying.
